criterion: B must strictly reduce median absolute log2(first/later) AND later-pass max/min in BOTH builds. Quality equality is reported separately and gates supported_without_quality_change. This is an engineering directional criterion, not significance.
interpretation: Descriptive measurement-qualification evidence, not final research findings. All five repetitions are retained. The same 200 queries are reused; repeated executions, conditions, and the two graph builds are not pooled as independent samples. No inferential test, cache-causality claim, or proof of steady state is made. Historical and pilot campaigns are context, not a matched comparison.

protocol.drift_band_interpretation: predeclared diagnostic tolerance, not proof of steady state
protocol.hypothesis_support: B lowers both median absolute log2 first/later query ratio and later-pass median range in both builds, evaluated separately for each method/filter
protocol.purpose: matched operational preparation-policy qualification, not cache-cause identification
